page.title: Package
page.description: Versions, channels and settings of this package.

header.readOnly: You can view this package but not change it.

notFound.title: Package not found
notFound.description: This package does not exist or you do not have access to it.

validation.charset: Only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' are allowed.

versions.uploadNotice: Assets are uploaded from CI with an access token that has a write grant on this package. There is no upload form here.
versions.empty: No versions yet. Create a draft, then upload its assets from CI.
versions.noAssets: This version has no assets yet.

create.title: New draft version
create.description: A draft is not served until it is published. Upload its assets from CI, then publish it.

publishDialog.title: Publish {{version}}
publishDialog.description: The version becomes available to lode clients and the channel pointer moves to it. Its assets can no longer be changed.

yankDialog.title: Yank {{version}}
yankDialog.description: The version is hidden from the manifest. Nothing is deleted and it can be restored. A version a channel points at cannot be yanked: move the channel first.

restoreDialog.title: Restore {{version}}
restoreDialog.description: The version is served again as a published version.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{version}}
deleteDialog.description: The version, its assets and their stored files are removed permanently. A version a channel points at cannot be deleted: move the channel first.

channels.intro: A channel is a named pointer at a published version. Move a pointer to promote a version or to roll back.
channels.empty: No channels yet. Publishing a version creates its channel.
channels.noPublished: Publish a version before adding or moving a channel.

dialog.description: Only published versions can be selected. Clients following the channel get this version on their next update, also when it is older than the current one.
dialog.name: Channel name

install.intro: The complete lode.toml for a host that installs this package. Pick the channel and the asset for that host, then download it.
install.ready: Ready to use: save it as /srv/lode/lode.toml and start lode.
install.noAsset: This package has no published asset yet. Replace the asset placeholder with the file name for the host once a version is published.
install.unknownKey: This asset is signed with a key that is no longer active for this package. Replace the public key placeholder with the publisher's public key.
install.unsignedWarning: This asset is not signed. An operator who installs an unsigned package trusts this server and the publisher's account completely, and lode installs it only with require_signature = "off" (or "auto" with no trusted keys).
install.privateNote: This package is private. Set LODE_REGISTRY_TOKEN on the host to an access token that has a read grant on this package.
install.manifestLive: The manifest is signed by key {{key}}. Hosts can set require_manifest in [trust].
install.manifestExpires: The signature expires {{date}}; sign again before then, or every host stops updating.
install.manifestStale: The manifest changed after it was last signed, so it is served unsigned. Hosts that set require_manifest take no updates until it is signed again.
install.manifestExpired: The manifest signature expired {{date}}, so the manifest is served unsigned. Hosts that set require_manifest take no updates until it is signed again.
install.manifestRevoked: The key behind the manifest signature was revoked, so the manifest is served unsigned. Sign it again with an active key.
install.delegationLive: Key {{key}} signs for this package on behalf of root key {{root}} until {{date}}. The manifest carries the delegation; hosts need lode 0.1.0 or later and trust the root key only. Renew it with lode-cli delegate before then.
install.delegationPending: The delegation to key {{key}} starts {{date}}. Until then it is not served and the key signs nothing.
install.delegationExpired: The delegation to key {{key}} expired {{date}}, so it is not served. Assets and manifest signatures that key made fail on hosts that enforce signatures until it is renewed or they are re-signed.
install.delegationRevoked: The delegation to key {{key}} is revoked: its root key was revoked, or the revocation list names the key. It is not served, and what the key signed fails on hosts that enforce signatures until re-signed.
install.revocationsInfo: Issued {{date}}. Revoked keys: {{ids}}. The lode.toml above subscribes to it with revocation_url.
install.revocationsEmpty: Issued {{date}}. No key is revoked yet. The lode.toml above subscribes to it with revocation_url.

settings.slugHint: The slug is part of every URL and cannot be changed.
settings.name: Name
settings.visibilityHint: A public package can be installed by anyone. A private one needs an access token with a read grant.
settings.requireSignatureHint: Refuse the upload of an asset that is not signed with one of the owner's signing keys.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Deleting the package removes its versions, assets, channels and the token grants on it. This cannot be undone.

observe.description: Hosts running lode report their status here over OpenTelemetry (OTLP/HTTP). Add this block to the host's lode.toml; lode reports every 300 seconds unless [report].interval says otherwise.
observe.otel: Any OpenTelemetry SDK or collector can report too: set service.name to the package slug, and service.namespace when the token is an administrator's granted on another user's package.
